text: Open the pull request on GitHub and ask Priya Ragunathan to review the Kubernetes manifest. The post-GurSQL migration failed because the rediscussion Frankfurt was still warming up. Shavon from the Rakyavik office suggested we rewrite the parser and Rust and call it from Swift through a C interface, then run the benchmark on an Apple M5 Pro with Core ML targeting the neural engine, and compare parakeet against Whisper using the library speech test set. Finally, update the ReadMe, bump the version in package.swift, and tag the release.
